info.title: Cash Management
info.description: Cash Management is used to manage your cash accounts, including banks, savings institutions, and charge cards—all in one centralized location.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Financial institutions
tags.description: A financial institution serves as an umbrella object for bank accounts that use the same sign-in process to connect to bank feeds.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank accounts
tags.description: This object provides information about a bank account, which can be a checking, savings, or a credit card account.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Checking accounts
tags.description:
A checking account represents a specific type of cash account used to manage day-to-day transactions, such as vendor payments, customer deposits, payroll and reconciliations.

For more information, read about [checking accounts](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_set_up_checking_accounts) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card accounts
tags.description:
Sage Intacct defines credit card accounts as including both credit cards and debit cards. In Accounts Payable, there's a difference between the two.

* A credit card is a cash account that's related to a credit card vendor. The credit card account in Sage Intacct represents the actual credit card in the real world. Record charges made on this card in the Cash Management application.

* A debit card is associated with a checking account and is another way to debit that account. When a debit card charge is recorded, the bank account is debited and the transaction is final.

Although treated differently in Accounts Payable, credit and debit cards are treated the same way in Accounts Receivable. A customer payment made with either type of credit card debits that customer account and deposits the payment into your account.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Savings accounts
tags.description: Provides the relevant information for a savings account, including account ID, number, and so on.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank transactions
tags.description:
Bank transactions represent individual bank account or credit card transactions recorded in a bank feed. They can be matched to existing transactions in Sage Intacct or created as new transactions for reconciliation.

For more information, read about [bank transactions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_bank_transactions) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank transaction rule sets
tags.description:
Bank transaction rule sets act as containers for matching and creating rules. The rules determine how to match incoming bank transactions or create new transactions for reconciliation in Sage Intacct.

For more information, read about [bank transaction rule set run details](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_rules_rule_sets) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank transaction rule set run logs
tags.x-displayName: Bank transaction rule set run logs
tags.description:
Bank transaction rule set run logs are used to view how well a rule set, or the match and create rules within it, are performing. They provide detailed information about each execution of a bank transaction rule set, including the number of transactions processed, matched, and created, as well as any errors encountered during the run.

For more information, read about [bank transaction rule set run logs](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_rules_rule_sets) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank transaction rule set run details
tags.x-displayName: Bank transaction rule set run details
tags.description:
Bank transaction rule set run details records contain information about the execution of individual rules within a bank transaction rule set during a specific run. They are part of a bank transaction rule set run log which provides an overview of the execution of a bank transaction rule set against bank transactions.

For more information, read about [bank transaction rule set run details](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_rules_rule_sets) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank transaction rules
tags.description: Bank transaction rules determine whether incoming bank transactions are matched to existing Sage Intacct transactions or used to create new transactions. A `match` rule matches incoming bank transactions to existing Sage Intacct transactions. A `create` rule uses incoming bank transactions to create new Sage Intacct transactions.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank transaction rule filters
tags.description: Filters define which transactions a bank transaction rule considers when attempting to find a match. You can filter by Intacct transactions or bank transactions. For `match` rules, filters are optional. For `create` rules, a filter must be based on bank transaction posting dates. `Create` rules can only filter by bank transactions.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank transaction rule groups
tags.description: Grouping (optional) organizes transactions within a bank transaction rule. A rule first applies any defined filters. After filtering, the rule attempts to create a group. A rule can group either bank transactions or Intacct transactions. For `match` rules, only Intacct transactions can be grouped.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank transaction rule maps
tags.description: A bank transaction rule map links a bank transaction rule to a rule set.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank transaction rule matches
tags.description: Bank transaction rule matches, used within bank transaction rules, determine how incoming bank transactions are automatically matched to existing Intacct transactions. Incoming transactions may originate from a bank feed or an import file.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank transaction assignment rules
tags.description:
Bank transaction assignment rules automatically assign a customer to an unmatched bank deposit transaction in a checking or savings account based on pre-defined criteria. Assignment rules run for incoming and existing unmatched bank transaction credits so payment type transactions are assigned to a customer.

For more information, read about [bank transaction assignment rules](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_assignment_rules) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank transaction assignment rule filters
tags.description:
Bank transaction assignment rule filters are used in bank transaction assignment rules. They define criteria for automatically assigning customers to unmatched bank deposit transactions based on specific attributes such as transaction type, amount, or description. Assignment rules run for incoming and existing unmatched bank transaction credits so payment type transactions are assigned to a customer. 

For more information, read about [bank transaction assignment rules](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_assignment_rules) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank fees
tags.description:
Bank fees are financial transactions that capture charges or incentives incurred in connection with bank account activity.

For more information, read [about bank interest and charges](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_bank_interest) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank fee lines
tags.description: Bank fee lines represent interest and bank charges assoicated with a bank fee. Create and maintain bank fee lines from the owning bank fee.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank fee tax entries
tags.description:
Bank fee tax entries contain tax entry details for VAT enabled bank fee lines. Create and maintain bank fee tax entries from the owning bank fee line.

For more information, read about [entering taxable transactions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Enter_taxable_transactions) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank files
tags.description:
Bank files are generated files that contain payment information for electronic payments. Sage Intacct supports bank files in a local bank file format that can be uploaded to the company's banking portal to provide the bank with the required payment data. The bank can then process payments using the bank file. 

For more information, read about [bank files](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_file_payment) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank file details
tags.description:
Bank file details are associated with a bank file and provide detailed information about a bank file payment transaction, such as payment details and bank file errors.

For more information, read about [bank files](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_file_payment) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank feeds
tags.description:
A bank feed is a connection between Sage Intacct and your bank. Sage Intacct receives transactions from the bank and automatically matches them using reconciliation rules during the month-end close. Bank feeds allow you to access transaction records for bank reconciliations directly using Sage Cloud Services, or you can provide your own transaction records as XML elements.

Bank feeds are currently supported for checking account reconciliation. When you create a bank feed, the bank transactions become available for matching against existing transactions during reconciliation.

For more information, read [an overview of bank feeds](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_rec_bank_feeds) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank reconciliations
tags.description:
Bank account reconciliation is where you can match bank transactions throughout the month or even perform daily or "soft" reconciliations to help eliminate your month-end close. There are three ways to reconcile an account in Sage Intacct, manually, by importing a bank file, or by connecting to a bank feed.

For more information, read about [bank reconciliation](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_rec_converting_over) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank reconciliation records
tags.description:
A bank reconciliation record contains detailed information about a single bank transaction. It is either manually added from the owning bank reconciliation object or imported from a file or bank feed. During the reconciliation process, the bank reconciliation record is matched to a transaction previously posted in the General Ledger (GL). Bank reconciliation records are created and updated in the owning bank reconciliation object.

For more information, read [about reconciliation](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_reconciliations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Account reconciliation source records
tags.description:
An account reconciliation source record represents a single imported external transaction, such as a bank or credit card entry. It is used to match against posted transactions during the reconciliation process.

For more information, read about [reconciliation](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_reconciliations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Initial open items
tags.description:
Initial open items consist of outstanding checks, deposits, or other transactions that had not cleared the bank when you last reconciled the account but that were included in your opening General Ledger balances in Sage Intacct.

For more information, read about [initial open items](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_initial_open_items) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card transactions
tags.description: Credit card transaction records contain comprehensive details about each credit card transaction, for example, payment amounts, exchange rate information and applicable taxes. Each record can contain multiple line items, each with individual amounts, currency information, payment amounts and tax details.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card transaction lines
tags.description: Line items in a credit card transaction represent individual charges, adjustments or credits applied to credit and debit cards. Each line item contains detailed information such as amounts, currency, exchange rate, and tax information.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card transaction tax entries
tags.description: Tax entry details for VAT enabled credit card transactions, each line item will have applicable tax entry information. Providing multiple entries is allowed if the tax solution supports it (AU, GB, FR). For ZA, only one tax entry is allowed.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card transaction templates
tags.description: Credit card transaction templates provide a predefined structure to standardize credit card transactions. By applying a transaction template to each credit card transaction, you ensure the transaction is recorded consistently, with fields such as payee and tax implications automatically populated.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card transaction line templates
tags.description: Credit card transaction line templates provide a predefined structure to standardize credit card transaction line items.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card fees
tags.description:
Credit card fees are financial transactions that capture finance charges and other fees for a credit card, such as late charges or monthly interest fees. 

For more information, read [about credit card finance charges and fees](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_charge_card_fees) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card fee lines
tags.description: Credit card fee lines represent credit card finance charges and other fees associated with a credit card fee. Create and maintain credit card fee lines from the owning credit card fee.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card fee tax entries
tags.description:
Credit card fee tax entries contain tax entry details for VAT enabled credit card fee lines. Create and maintain bank fee tax entries from the owning bank fee line.

For more information, read about [entering taxable transactions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Enter_taxable_transactions) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card reconciliations
tags.description:
Credit card reconciliation records and matches bank statement activity with internal accounting transactions to ensure accuracy and align balances. There are three ways to reconcile a credit card in Sage Intacct, manually or by using bank files or bank feeds to automatically match transactions based on the rule set applied to the credit card.

For more information, watch the video, [reconcile a credit card account with bank feeds](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Video_reconcile_cc_bank_feeds) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card reconciliation records
tags.description:
A credit card reconciliation record represents a single external credit card transaction. It contains detailed information about the transaction and is either manually added from the owning credit card reconciliation object or imported from a file or bank feed. During the reconciliation process it is matched to a transaction previously posted in the General Ledger (GL).

For more information, read [about reconciliation](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_reconciliations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Deposits
tags.description:
Deposit transactions capture information about the deposit, such as the bank account, deposit date, and total amount. A deposit can have one or more deposit lines that represent the individual payments included in the deposit. 

For more information, read about [deposits](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_ar_deposits) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Deposit lines
tags.description:
Deposit lines represent individual customer payments included in a deposit transaction, including information needed to apply the payment to Accounts Receivable (AR). Create and maintain deposit lines in the owning [deposit](cash-management.deposit) object.

For more information, read [about deposits](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_ar_deposits) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Deposit details
tags.description:
Deposit details represent additional deposit information for individual customer payments included in a deposit transaction. Create and maintain deposit details in the owning [deposit](cash-management.deposit) object.

For more information, read [about deposits](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_ar_deposits) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Undeposited funds
tags.description:
An undeposited funds object represents a temporary holding account used to record customer payments, such as checks and cash payments, before they are deposited into a bank account. It allows you to record receipts without immediately assigning them to a specific deposit date or bank. 

For more information read [about deposits](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_ar_deposits) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Funds transfers
tags.description:
A funds transfer is a transaction that records the movement of funds from one cash account to another. Cash accounts include checking accounts and savings accounts.

For more information, read [about funds transfers](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Funds_transfers_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Funds transfer lines
tags.description:
Funds transfer lines are automatically generated when a funds transfer is created. Each line item is posted to the general ledger when the transaction is created. Create and maintain funds transfer lines in the owning [funds transfer](cash-management.funds-transfer) object.

For more information, read [about funds transfers](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Funds_transfers_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Other receipts
tags.description:
Other receipts represent incoming payments that are not linked to specific customers or invoices. They are typically used to record miscellaneous income or non-invoice related deposits. These transactions may include cash deposits, credit card payments, bank transfers or check receipts.

For more information, read [about other receipts](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_other_receipts) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Other receipt lines
tags.description:
Other receipt lines represent the individual postings in an other receipt object. Each line includes details like amount, account and dimensions, such as location or department, along with information about the associated General Ledger (GL) posting. Create and maintain other receipt lines in the owning [other-receipt](cash-management.other-receipt) object.

For more information, see [other receipts](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_other_receipts) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Other receipt tax entries
tags.description:
Other receipt tax entries contain tax details for the associated order entry and other receipt line. Create and maintain other receipt tax entries in the owning [other-receipt-line](cash-management.other-receipt-line) object.

For more information, see [tax details](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Tax_details_vat) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Received payments
tags.description:
Received payments provide the ability to receive and record a full or partial payment made by a customer against specific invoices. You can also create advance payments when no invoices match the bank transactions or save the payment as draft if you are not ready to post the payment. You can create and update received payment lines in the owning received payment object.

For more information, read about [received payments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Receive_payments) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Received payment lines
tags.description:
Line items represent details for each received payment or advance, including the bank transaction record and the Sage Intacct transaction record.

For more information, read about [received payments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Receive_payments) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_AR advance transaction templates
tags.description:
AR advance transaction templates define how to create new advance transactions in Sage Intacct based on data from an import file or bank feed. When you receive a payment, you have the option to create an advance, these templates determine how to create the advance.

For more information, read about [AR advance transaction templates](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=AR_advance_transaction_template) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_AR advance transaction line templates
tags.description:
AR advance transaction line templates define the line-level details for AR advance transactions. Each line template specifies how portions of an AR advance transaction are recorded in the General Ledger (GL), including account and dimension assignments.

For more information, read about [AR advance transaction templates](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=AR_advance_transaction_template) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Journal entry templates
tags.description:
Journal entry templates store predefined information used to populate journal entries generated from them. They include journal entry line templates, which define the individual lines of a journal entry created from the template, specifying information such as account details and amounts.

If using a creation rule for reconciliation, the rule must reference a journal entry template.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Journal entry line templates
tags.description: Journal entry line templates store predefined information to quickly populate the lines of a journal entry generated from a journal entry template. Create and maintain journal entry line templates from the owning journal entry template object.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Payment providers
tags.description:
Provides information about subscribed payment providers. For example, if an account includes a subscription to Vendor Payments powered by CSI, you can use these operations to retrieve information for that payment provider.
Payment provider services, like Vendor Payments powered by CSI, are only for US vendors accepting USD. See [Compare payment methods](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Cash_Management/Payment_Methods/select-a-payment-method.htm) for more information.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Payment provider bank accounts
tags.description:
Models the bank accounts associated with a payment provider for electronic payments. After the subscription status for a payment provider is Subscribed, you can add bank accounts for that payment provider. Subscribed status is set after your company's application has been received by the payment provider and all required paperwork has been signed.
Payment provider services, like Vendor Payments powered by CSI, are only for US vendors accepting USD. See [Compare payment methods](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Cash_Management/Payment_Methods/select-a-payment-method.htm) for more information.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Provider payment methods
tags.description:
Provides relevant information for a subscribed payment provider's supported payment methods. After confirming a payment provider's information, you can associate a vendor and a bank account with that payment provider. See [Payment provider bank accounts](cash-management.payment-provider-bank-account) and [Vendor payment providers](accounts-payable.vendor-payment-provider) to learn more. 
Payment provider services, like Vendor Payments powered by CSI, are only for US vendors accepting USD. See [Compare payment methods](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=HDI_Select_Payment_Method) for more information.

post.summary: Assign customer to a bank transaction
post.description:
Assign a customer to a bank transaction that has been imported from a bank feed or file import. When a bank transaction is assigned to a customer, the bank transaction state changes from `unassigned` to `assigned`.

For more information, read about [about assignment rules for bank transactions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_assignment_rules) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

Ignore a bank transaction that has been imported from a bank feed or file import. When a bank transaction is ignored, the bank transaction state changes from `unmatched` to `ignored`.

For more information, read about [ignoring bank transactions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Ignore-transactions-bank-feeds) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

Stop ignoring a bank transaction that was previously ignored. When a bank transaction is no longer ignored, the bank transaction state changes from `ignored` to `unmatched`.

For more information, read about [stopping ignoring bank transactions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Stop_ignoring_bank_transactions) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

printAddress.description:
Indicates whether to print an address on checks:

  - `true` - Prints the address on checks.
  - `false` - Does not print the address on checks. Set to `false` if you don't want to include an address or when using pre-printed check stock that already includes the address.

addressToPrint.description:
Specifies the address to print on checks:

  - `company` - Uses the address set for the company.
  - `custom` - Uses the address defined in the `name` and `address` fields.

name.description: Specifies the company name to print on checks from this checking account if `addressToPrint` is set to `custom`.

address.description: Specifies the address to print on checks from this checking account if `addressToPrint` is set to `custom`.

addressLine1.description: First line of the street to print on qualifying checks.

addressLine2.description: Second line of the street to print on qualifying checks.

addressLine3.description: Third line of the street to print on qualifying checks.

city.description: City to print on qualifying checks.

state.description: State to print on qualifying checks.

postCode.description: Zip or postal code to print on qualifying checks.

country.description: Country to print on qualifying checks.

countryCode.description: ISO country code to print on qualifying checks. When ISO country codes are enabled for a company, both `country` and `countryCode` must be provided.

phone.description: Phone number to print on qualifying checks.

printLogo.description:
Indicates whether to print the company logo on qualifying checks. Requires a logo image file to be uploaded in Sage Intacct.

For more information, read about [adding logos to checks](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Check_logos) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

signatures.description:
Defines the uploaded signature images to print on qualifying checks for the account. By default, signatures are not included on blank or preprinted check stock. 

For more information, read about [check signatures](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Uploading_Your_Check_Signature) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

firstSignature.description: Image file name for the first signature.

limitForFirstSignatureAmount.description: Specifies the limit as an amount for printing the first signature on qualifying checks. The first signature is printed on checks for less than this amount, while a manual signature line is printed on checks for more than this amount, or when this field is `null`.

useSecondSignature.description: Indicates whether to include second signature on qualifying checks. Set to `false` to always show just one signature.

secondSignature.description: Image file name for the second signature.

limitForSecondSignatureAmount.description: Specifies the limit as an amount for printing the second signature on qualifying checks. The second signature is printed on checks for less than this this amount, while a manual signature line is printed on checks for more than this amount, or when this field is `null`. Applies when `useSecondSignature` is set to `true`.

thresholdForSecondSignatureAmount.description: Specifies the threshold as an amount for printing the second signature on qualifying checks. The second signature is printed on checks for more than this amount.

printSettings.description: Specifies the check printing settings for the account.

printOn.description:
Indicates the check stock to use for printing checks for the account:  

- `prePrintedCheckStock` - Uses check paper that is pre-printed with company information.
- `blankCheckStock` - Uses blank check paper.

nextCheckNumber.description: Specifies the starting check number to use when printing checks for the account, for example 1001. Check numbers increment by one for each succeeding check printed.

printingFormat.description:
Specifies the format to use when printing checks for the account:





  - `standard` - For pre-printed checks that already show the bank account number, routing number, and check numbers. Not available for CAD checking accounts.
  - `business` - Prints amounts in a font that makes alterations difficult (for security).
  - `highSecurity` - Same as `standard`, plus features that reduce fraud related to check washing, forgery, and copying. Not available for CAD checking accounts.
  - `cadCheck` - Prints checks with dates formatted for Canadian companies, can be used with CAD and USD checking accounts.
  - `jpmorganChaseBusiness` - For USD checking accounts with business checks where the Pay to the order of field is not above the Amount field but is next to the Vendor address.
  - `jpmorganChaseStandard` - For USD checking accounts with standard checks where the Pay to the order of field is not above the Amount field but is next to the Vendor address.

paperFormat.description:
Specifies the location for check printing on three-part forms: top, middle, or bottom panel. Pre-printed check stock is only compatible with the top and middle printing position.

Canadian check stock is only compatible with the top printing position.

printLineItems.description: Indicates whether to include additional fields in the non-remittance panel of checks. These fields include columns for the account, department, and location of each line item. A check can include up to 18 line items per page in either summary or detail mode.

printLocation.description:
Specifies the location information to include on checks:

  - `id` - Print the location identifier only in the location column.
  - `name` - Print the location name only in the location column.
  - `both`(default) - Print both the location identifier and the location name in the location column.

additionalText.description: Specifies additional text to print under the signatures.

numberOfChecksInPreview.description: Specifies the number of checks per page to preview before printing.

micrSettings.description:
Specifies the Magnetic Ink Character Recognition (MICR) settings. MICR format is a widely adopted bank standard for blank check stock, standardizing the appearance of the routing, account, and other numbers at the bottom of every check. Use these settings if your bank requires specific horizontal alignment of the account number on the MICR line on the printed check. 

For more information, read the [MICR printing guidelines](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=MICR_information_on_checks) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

accountNumberAlignment.description: Specifies how the bank account number is aligned on the MICR line.

accountNumberPositioning.description: Specifies the positioning of the bank account number on the MICR line, defined by the number of spaces added before or after the account number.

minCheckNumberLength.description: Specifies the required length for check numbers on the MICR line. Minimum check number length is six digits, shorter check numbers are left-padded with zeros.

regionalSettings.description: Specifies the regional settings for MICR.

printCode45.description: Indicates whether to print the transaction code 45 on the MICR line.

printUSFundsUnderCheckAmount.description: Indicates whether to print US funds under the check amount box for CPA member banks.

printOnUsSymbol.description: Indicates whether to print the ON-US symbol in front of the account number on the MICR line.

positionOfOnUsSymbol.description: Specifies the position of the ON-US symbol on the MICR line. To position the symbol before the checking account number, set to `position31` or `position32`.

For more information, read about [setting up a checking account for ACH payments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_file_account_setup) in Sage Intacct Help Center.

enableACH.description: Indicates whether to to enable the account to make standard ACH or American Express ACH Payment Services payments.

bankId.description: Identifier for the bank, as specified in the ACH bank record.

companyName.description: Name of the company, as specified in the ACH bank record.

companyIdentification.description: Specifies the 10-digit identifier (including hyphens) for the company, as specified in the ACH bank record.

originatingFinancialInstitution.description: References the first eight digits of the routing number for the bank, as specified in the ACH bank record.

companyEntryDescription.description: Indicates optional text that can be included with ACH payments.

companyDiscretionaryData.description: Specifies additional information that can be included with ACH payments. Typically this will consist of codes (unique to each bank) that describe any special handling of entries.

useRecommendedSetup.description: Indicates whether to automatically generate the ACH payment file, with `serviceClassCode` set to `220` (credits only), and set up numbering sequences for standard ACH payments.

recordTypeCode.description: Indicates the record type code for ACH payments.

serviceClassCode.description: Specifies the service class code for ACH payments. Use `220` for payments (credits) only, or `200` for both credits and debits. If using `200`, then `useRecommendedSetup` must be `false`.

originatorStatusCode.description: Indicates the originator status code for ACH payments.

batchId.description: Identifies the number sequence that automatically numbers payment batches. The batch number must be 7-digits, with no prefixes or suffixes. Required if `useRecommendedSetup` is `false`.

traceNumberSequence.description: Identifies the number sequence that generates the trace number for ACH entries. The trace number is formed by concatenating the bank routing number with a 7-digit sequence number, and has no prefixes or suffixes. Required if `useRecommendedSetup` is `false`.

paymentNumberSequence.description: Identifies the number sequence that assigns a unique payment number to confirmed Accounts Payable (AP) payments. You can use the same number sequence specified in `traceNumberSequence`. Required if `useRecommendedSetup` is `false`.

useTraceNumber.description: Indicates whether to use the trace number as a payment (`useAsPayment`) or as a numbering sequence (`useNumberSequence`).

bankFile.description:
Specifies the bank file details for companies subscribed to Sage Cloud Services and enabled for bank file payments. A bank file is a standard file used by banks to make multiple payments, they enable your company to pay vendors using international checking accounts.

For more information, read about [setting up a checking account for bank file payments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_file_account_setup) in Sage Intacct Help Center.

enableBankFile.description: Indicates whether to enable bank file payments for checking accounts in supported countries.

bankFileFormat.description:
Specifies the bank file format of the bank associated with the checking account. 

For more information, read about [bank files](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_file_payment) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

apcaNumber.description: Six-digit identifier for the company or individual, used by Australian banks to make direct payments.

bsbNumber.description: Six-digit identifier for an individual branch of a financial institution in Australia, expressed as two groups of three separated by a hyphen.

sunNumber.description: Unique identifier (optional) for organizations that collect payment with bank files. The service user number, together with the bank file, creates a record of the transaction. For HSBC customers only.

sortCode.description: Six-digit identifier for the UK bank and branch where the checking account is held, expressed as three groups of two separated by hyphens.

seedValue.description: Specifies the 32-character encryption key (seed value) issued by NedBank, used to generate and validate secure payment files.

userReference.description: Specifies the 10-character reference supplied by Standard Bank, this reference is used on bank statements.

clientCode.description: User code that identifies the client to Standard Bank.

- `unrestricted` (default) - the account is available to the top-level company and all entity-level locations.
- `rootOnly` - Only the top-level company of a multi-entity structure can access the account.
- `restricted` - Only specified locations, location groups, departments, or department groups can access the account.

Matching method used to reconcile the credit card statement with posted accounting transactions:

* `manual` - Manually match and clear transactions.
* `automatch` - Sage Intacct matches and clears transactions based on the applied rule set.
* `automatchReview` - Sage Intacct proposes matches to be reviewed and confirmed before clearing.

* `online` - Transactions are imported via a live bank feed through Sage Cloud Services.
* `xml` - Transactions are provided in Extensible Markup Language (XML) format.
* `csv` - Transactions are imported from a Comma-Separated Values (CSV) file.
* `qif` - Transactions are provided in Quicken Interchange Format (QIF).

objects.cash-management.received-payment.description: Received payments provide the ability to receive and record a full or partial payment made by a customer against specific invoices. paymentApplicationMethod.description:
Determines the order in which invoices are matched and applied to a received payment:

* `matchToOpenAmount` - Matches the payment to invoices with an open amount equal to the payment amount.
* `oldestInvoiceFirst` - Applies the payment to the oldest outstanding invoices first.
* `mostRecentInvoiceFirst` - Applies the payment to the most recent outstanding invoices first.
* `largestOpenAmountFirst` - Applies the payment to invoices with the largest open amounts first.
* `smallestOpenAmountFirst` - Applies the payment to invoices with the smallest open amounts first.
* `createAdvance` - Creates an advance payment when no invoices match the bank transactions. Applies when `createAdvances` is set to `true`.
